decision.observation: Clean recovery: 11 mph, gear 1, all dots pale, no red markers. Car centred on wide gravel; the road ahead bends gently left, then sweeps right up-frame through birch and pine, with a lake upper-left.
decision.hypothesis: Centred on a wide lane with the curve ahead — plain throttle should keep building speed and let the car follow the bend.
decision.memory: The long W+A recovery from the right verge landed the car perfectly centred at 11 mph — the most effective single correction seen.
